pages.text: Health 4, Attack 0.5, Speed 0.2.$(br)An ordinary two-block snowman; a little tinkering taught you how to make this pile of snow a good deal more loyal.
Place a $(l)Vitality Carved Pumpkin$() on top of two snow blocks.

5, Speed 0.2.$(br)It still throws snowballs, only straighter and at the right people. When a friendly Mutant Snow Golem nearby is hurt it throws snowballs to heal it - once within six blocks with a clear line it stops closing and just throws, until the target is whole or two snow golems are already tending it.
